## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-015615ce)

## Summary

Adds the numbered 「手順」 journey strip to the room workspace — the same state-driven guide measurement (#478) and optimization (#484) already have — so the five flat context tabs (geometry/objects/placement/acoustics/history) now express the canonical first-build order: **shape → walls/openings → speakers/equipment → seats → acoustic surfaces**.

- `room_journey.py` (new): pure `evaluate_room_journey(**signals)` → 5 `RoomJourneyStep`s (`done`/`current`/`pending`/`blocked`, JA detail, owning context). Signals are persisted state only — the saved head revision (`repository.latest`) plus document sidecars (materials, treatments, poses, predictions) — never the working draft. The only hard gate is a saved room (everything downstream is `blocked`); the rest is a recommended order, and out-of-order completions stay `done`. Optional/tool surfaces (history context, listener poses, treatments, predictions) ride inside step details instead of earning spine positions — same rule that keeps interventions/robustness off the optimization spine.
- `room_workspace.py`: strip rendered under the context tab bar (title + `N/5` progress + numbered buttons + 「次にやること」 hint + 「現在の手順を開く」). Refresh runs from `_refresh()` (the universal mutation funnel) and `set_context()` (acoustics-panel sidecar writes bypass `_refresh`). Step clicks prefer `WorkspaceDeepLink` via a new optional `on_navigate` kwarg (wired in `workflow_application._make_room`), falling back to `set_context`. Speaker-step detail surfaces the real blockers Overview readiness uses: unassigned `UNASSIGNED-<n>` roles and duplicated channel roles.
- Compact reflow: journey buttons live in a `QGridLayout` — one row normally, 3-per-row under the existing `<900px` responsive-compact breakpoint, so the strip doesn't pin a wide minimum width on the workspace (caught by `test_room_workspace_compact_layout_…`).
- `application_pages.py`: audit of the other top-level destinations found Projects/Inbox/Library/Support/Settings already carry hint lines + per-control tooltips + empty-state next steps; the one gap was Activity — its hint now names the next-step affordance (timeline rows double-click to the owning screen). No numbered strips added to single-purpose pages.
- `test_room_journey.py` (new): evaluator truth table (gate, skip-able openings, role blockers, out-of-order dones) + strip rendering/routing/deep-link/persisted-vs-draft tests mirroring `test_optimization_journey.py`.
